body_md:
Three Certified Electrical Contractors in this Miami-area set have a Current, Active license on a state licensing board lookup: Baltic Electrical LLC (EC13010446), Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC (EC13008804), and Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. (EC13007781). Origins Electric Corp and Y&M Electrical Contractor Inc. are listed from their business sites, and their license status here is unknown. Compare named owners, service areas, and stated services to narrow the five.

## How we picked

Each listing was checked for trade, license number, license status, license source, service area, years in business, named owner, stated services, hours, and prices. Current, Active status for Baltic Electrical LLC, Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC, and Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. comes from a state licensing board lookup. For Origins Electric Corp and Y&M Electrical Contractor Inc., the source is the business site; a linkable state board lookup page for the license was not retrieved, so status is unknown. Hours are stated only for Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC. Prices are unknown for all five. Facts for each business link to the source used for that listing.

## Things to know before you go

Baltic Electrical LLC and Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC state Miami-Dade and Broward counties. Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. is in Homestead, FL 33033, owner Ivan Alonso, and states Homestead and the Miami area, residential and commercial. It started as a one-man operation in 2016, states 24-hour emergency service, and license EC13007781 is Current, Active. Origins Electric Corp is in Miami, FL, owner Miguel Angel Diaz, with more than seven years in business. It states Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach counties, plus service upgrades, panel replacements, lighting installations, and commercial build-outs.

Only Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC lists set hours. Emergency service is also stated by Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. and Y&M Electrical Contractor Inc. Hours are unknown for Baltic Electrical LLC, Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc., Origins Electric Corp, and Y&M Electrical Contractor Inc. Prices are unknown for all five; only Y&M Electrical Contractor Inc. states free estimates.

## FAQ

### Which listings show a Current, Active state license?
Baltic Electrical LLC (EC13010446), Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC (EC13008804), and Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. (EC13007781). Each is a Certified Electrical Contractor with Current, Active status from a state licensing board lookup. Origins Electric Corp and Y&M Electrical Contractor Inc. have unknown license status here. Y&M lists EC13009660 on its business site; Origins Electric Corp's license number is unknown.

### Who states hours or emergency service?
Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC states Mon-Sat 7:00 AM-8:00 PM, Sunday emergency only, and 24/7 emergency. Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. states 24-hour emergency service. Y&M Electrical Contractor Inc. states 24/7 emergency response. Hours are unknown for the other listings.

### What should I match before calling?
Match your county or city to the stated service area, and the job to stated services. Panel upgrades, EV chargers, generators, smart home, recertification, lighting, and commercial work are not listed for every business. Prices are unknown for all five; Y&M Electrical Contractor Inc. states free estimates.
